scope: Language coverage of the next source corpus; not new political ratings

official_context.claim: Kinyarwanda is the common language across Rwanda; the government also lists English, French and Kiswahili as official languages.

collection_policy.if_filter_is_required: Include every supported core language and retain mixed or undetermined language records; keep Russian as additional context when available.
collection_policy.kinyarwanda_not_supported: Record the missing coverage; obtain accessible local-source or verified-author exports rather than treating an English/French-only corpus as locally complete.

translation_and_attribution.video_audio: Retain original media URL, transcript language and timestamps for cited spans.
translation_and_attribution.political_context: Keep speaker, institution, subject of the position and audience context; an international-language address and a local-language address need not discuss the same political level.
translation_and_attribution.uncertain_political_meaning: Review in context and, when needed, with a competent speaker; do not turn an uncertain translation into a confident rating.
translation_and_attribution.low_detector_or_model_support: Keep the original and flag for review; do not silently drop Kinyarwanda or mixed-language evidence.
